visualCharacteristics.purpose: Testimonial tabs: avatar/name/role tab buttons switching quotation panels

contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: (1) tab label - avatar image, name, role; (2) panel - image, name (bold), role, quotation paragraph
contentPattern.description: Tabs: 4 tabs with avatar+name+role labels, each panel image + name + role + quotation — Interactive tabbed component; quotations stay inside their tab panels with all labels and images
contentPattern.notes: 4 rows: Alex Rivera, Taylor Kim, Jordan Ellis, Morgan Blake

usage: Customer or community testimonials switched by person.
reuseGuidance: Use for person-based tabbed quotes. The last paragraph of the panel is treated as the quote.
